name: devflow
description: An Issue-driven development loop for Claude Code and Codex: one lifecycle skill, devflow, resumes from Issues, delegates reads and checks, and leaves checking to review and CI in repositories with a .devflow.json. Also ships four independent skills the loop does not call: decision-interview, write-prompts, audit-prompts and agent-instruction-design.

interface.longDescription: devflow supports consequential changes and handoffs through Change, Resume, and Delivery. In repositories with a .devflow.json, it resumes Issue-tracked work, delegates reads and checks to fresh-context agents, and follows the lifecycle from discovery to branch cleanup. Lifecycle hooks inject the resume card, continue autonomous work within task limits, and release sessions when they end. Four independent skills ship alongside: decision-interview, write-prompts, audit-prompts and agent-instruction-design.
defaultPrompt: Check the status and next action for an assigned change.
Review PR readiness without making changes.
Check which recorded verification results can be reused.
